findings.missing_scope: Settings Privacy > Never ask on these sites contains a per-origin Ask again action; Settings Scrape > Auto-scrape mode has Capture and Scroll & capture choices. Neither appears among the 27 Settings controls or their generated cases.
findings.applicability: Settings is visible to guest, member, and admin; the Never ask list appears when origins exist. Test data/state preconditions are needed, not a new access gate.

findings.missing_scope: Chat's guest banner has Sign in and Sign up free actions. The 131 Chat controls include neither guest action; Sign up free opens the frontend in a new browser tab. Add guest-only control cases while keeping Chat execution in wave D.
findings.applicability: Guest only after auth hydration; banner disappears when signed in.

findings.missing_scope: The popup inventory calls its second action 'Open side panel in a new tab', but popup/main.tsx renders 'Open chat' and 'Capture page'; both call the same openSidePanel function and neither opens a new tab or selects a destination. The popup entrypoint is excluded from Chrome Web Store builds by filterEntrypoints, while the inventory marks all popup cases applicable to all personas without a build variant. Model the two actual local/unpacked buttons and Store action-click flow separately.
findings.applicability: Local/unpacked popup: guest gets Sign in, signed-in member/admin get both buttons. Store build: no popup page. Mic grant and options are separate entrypoints.

findings.missing_scope: Both Chat and Pilot list 'Agent picker detail sneak peek'. The package renders Sneak Peek only when the host supplies openPeek, and sidepanel App supplies no such port; its own comment says the affordance is hidden. Remove the impossible test cases or classify them explicitly as non-applicable.
findings.applicability: Neither Chat nor Pilot in this extension, all personas. The shared package code and lockfile agree on 0.13.10.

findings.missing_scope: The inventory calls the agent picker's fourth ownership tab 'System' for Chat and Pilot. These hosts do not pass systemTabLabel or includeSystemInAll. Package AgentListTabs uses its public label by default; System is only an admin-surface override. Test the actual public/builtin tab label and avoid asserting a System tab in these pickers.
findings.applicability: Chat signed-in member/admin picker and Pilot admin picker; Chat guest has no picker.

findings.missing_scope: Recorder inventory covers recording, permission recovery, clear, remove, and copy ID but omits the saved recording's Open link. This is an independent file-navigation control, conditional on fileUrl.
findings.applicability: Signed-in member/admin with a saved recording carrying fileUrl.

findings.missing_scope: The shell's Tab triggers control names only nine tabs; App renders 22 tab triggers. Other feature records cover their contents, but shell navigation and stale-selection cases lack explicit triggers for Chat, Pilot, Tasks, Lists, Agenda, Saved captures, Capture, Data, Notes, Files, Vault and Tools. Record the full trigger roster and its audience table once.
findings.applicability: Five public tabs: Chat, Scrape, Data, SEO, Settings. Signed-in additions: Tasks, Agenda, Lists, Saved captures, Capture, Highlights, Guidance, Notes, Files, Screenshots, Vault, Tools, Profile via User menu. Admin additions: Pilot, Showcase, Broker, Debug.
